COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
Talent Acquisition Recruiting Coordinator
6+ Month Contract Opportunity
New York, NY
KKR seeks an exceptional, highly motivated recent graduate to join the firm’s Talent Acquisition team as an Analyst supporting the Head of Talent Acquisition. This is a unique opportunity for someone early in their career to gain broad exposure to recruiting, Human Resources, and the asset management industry while working closely with the leader of KKR’s global recruiting function.
The Analyst will serve as a key partner to the Head of Talent Acquisition, helping manage a portfolio of senior and strategic searches while supporting the reporting, analytics, and day-to-day operations of the global Talent Acquisition function. The role combines recruiting coordination, data and analysis, project management, and operating support, providing visibility into both the strategic and executional sides of recruiting.
The successful candidate will gain firsthand exposure to how a global Talent Acquisition function operates within a leading alternative asset manager, including how senior and executive searches are managed from initial strategy through offer and close; how recruiting priorities connect to broader business objectives; and how recruiting data, compensation and offer approvals, and executive search firm relationships are managed. The role will also provide significant exposure to senior executives, recruiters, candidates, and external partners across KKR's global organization.
The Head of Talent Acquisition will work closely with this individual, making this an excellent opportunity for someone who is intellectually curious, eager to learn, and interested in building a strong foundation in recruiting, Human Resources, financial services, or asset management.
Because the role involves highly confidential recruiting, compensation, candidate, and financial information, exceptional judgment, maturity, integrity, and discretion are essential.
This is a contract position requiring a minimum six-month commitment.
Responsibilities:
Recruiting Coordination & Support to the Head of Talent Acquisition
Serve as a day-to-day organizational partner to the Head of Talent Acquisition, helping manage priorities and drive senior and strategic searches forward.
Help manage a portfolio of approximately 8–10 active searches, tracking candidates, interviews, feedback, decisions, and next steps
Coordinate complex interview processes across multiple time zones, including scheduling, logistics, candidate communications, and feedback
Provide a high-touch, white-glove experience for candidates and coordinate effectively with senior KKR stakeholders
Maintain accurate candidate and search information in Greenhouse and other recruiting/project management systems
Anticipate upcoming needs, maintain action items, proactively flag outstanding issues, and help ensure searches and other priorities remain on track
Prepare and organize materials for recruiting discussions, meetings, and senior management updates
Support recruiting events, special projects, and other Talent Acquisition initiatives as needed
Global Talent Acquisition Reporting & Operations
Support the reporting, analytics, and key operating processes used to manage KKR's global Talent Acquisition function.
Coordinate the monthly collection of recruiting updates from 25+ recruiters globally and consolidate activity into clear, concise reporting for senior leadership
Organize and analyze recruiting data to identify key themes and trends and prepare reporting for KKR's CFO and other senior stakeholders
Create polished Excel analyses, PowerPoint presentations, and other management reporting materials
Coordinate the twice-weekly preparation of offer approval requests for CFO review, ensuring submissions are complete, accurate, and well organized
Maintain records and proactively follow up with recruiters and other stakeholders on missing information and outstanding items
Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve recurring reporting and operational processes through AI and other technology-enabled solutions
Executive Search Firm Management
Support the administration, tracking, and analysis of KKR's executive search firm activity.
Receive, organize, and track executive search firm invoices, engagements, and related fees
Maintain accurate records and assist with reporting and analysis of executive search activity and expenditures
Coordinate with recruiters and other internal stakeholders to resolve questions and ensure information is complete and accurate
Support other executive search and recruiting-related projects as needed
Across all responsibilities, handle highly sensitive candidate, employee, compensation, and business information with exceptional discretion and judgment.
Ideal Experience:
Our ideal candidate is an outstanding recent college graduate with a strong academic record and demonstrated analytical experience gained through internships, academic work, or involvement in consulting, finance, investment, or other business-focused organizations. Candidates should have strong Excel and PowerPoint skills and experience analyzing data, identifying key insights, and translating findings into clear, polished deliverables. Prior exposure to financial services, consulting, asset management, Human Resources, or another analytically rigorous environment is a plus.

jobs.description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Position Summary We are hiring a Sr Staff Endpoint Architect — one of the Windows architects — to provide strategic, functional, and technical leadership for Windows architecture. This is a senior architect role focused on designing Windows solutions for business partner requests and enhancements, enforcing architecture governance, and conducting formal review of endpoint-impacting changes. The role works closely with the Windows Product Owner and the Device Configuration Owner to translate business needs into robust, secure, and repeatable Windows designs. This is an architect/leadership role, not a hands-on senior engineer position. Primary Focus / Outcomes Design for business requests & enhancements: Produce clear, scalable and secure Windows architecture and solution designs in response to requests and enhancement initiatives from business partners and product teams. Architecture governance & review: Participate in and help operate formal architecture governance for Windows (standards, baselines, decision records), including formal technical review and approval of endpoint-impacting changes. Functional/technical leadership: Provide authoritative architectural guidance and guardrails to desktop engineering, Device Configuration, and other implementation teams — enabling them to execute while maintaining architectural integrity. Cross-team collaboration: Work with the Windows Product Owner, Device Configuration team, Security, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to ensure designs meet functional, security, regulatory, and operational requirements. Roles & Responsibilities Act as one of the enterprise Windows architects responsible for producing and reviewing solution designs for business partner requests and product enhancements. Translate business requirements into architecture blueprints, reference designs, configuration guidance, and documented tradeoffs for assigned initiatives. Participate in (or co-run) the Endpoint/Windows Architecture Review Board (ARB) with the Windows Product Owner and Device Configuration Owner and other stakeholders to vet and approve endpoint-impacting designs and changes. Perform formal architecture reviews, risk assessments, and provide remediation or alternative design recommendations when needed. Produce and maintain architecture artifacts for assigned domains: reference architectures , decision records, technical standards, and review checklists that implementation teams can consume. Define and enforce Windows baselines, hardening guidance, and configuration expectations relevant to assigned projects — in partnership with Device Configuration (not as the unilateral owner of the platform). Influence vendor selection and solution evaluation for Windows-centric components tied to requests and enhancements; articulate long-term architectural implications to procurement and leadership. Ensure designs comply with regulatory, security, and operational controls in regulated environments; work with Security and Compliance to align on mitigations. Mentor and upskill engineers and architects on architectural reasoning, review discipline, and governance practices — focus on enabling teams versus day-to-day implementation. Minimum Requirements / Qualifications 10+ years of IT experience with progressive responsibility in architecture, platform ownership, or technical leadership, with a strong emphasis on Windows architecture at scale. Deep, demonstrable expertise in enterprise Windows architecture (Windows 10/11 Modern Desktop, servicing/feature management, modern management patterns). Strong experience with endpoint governance processes and tooling (SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune/MEM, Entra ID/Active Directory, VDI, WS1/AirWatch, etc.). Proven experience translating business requirements into architecture blueprints and formal design artifacts. Experience participating in or running Architecture Review Boards or equivalent governance processes. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills; history of working closely with product owners, configuration teams, and business partners. Strong written and verbal communication — able to document, defend, and present architecture decisions and tradeoffs to technical and business audiences. Experience in regulated environments is required . Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Windows architect within a team of architects (i.e., not sole platform owner) collaborating with product owners and configuration teams. Background in endpoint security architecture and integration of Windows design with enterprise security strategy. Familiarity with cloud identity and device management (Azure, Entra, Intune) and how these integrate with Windows design patterns. Experience with formal architecture tooling, decision-record practices, and governance metrics. Non-Negotiable Hiring Criteria Clear evidence of functional/technical leadership and architecture governance experience. Demonstrated ability to lead architectural reviews and influence decisions without being a primary hands-on implementer. Exceptional communication and documentation skills; ability to translate business asks to architectural solutions. Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholde r priorities. P roficien t in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and effectively across a range of business contexts. This role is strategic and architectural — we are not hiring a primarily hands-on Sr Engineer.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role:
Biology is the area where scientific progress has perhaps the greatest potential to directly and unambiguously improve human life — and we believe powerful AI could meaningfully accelerate the rate of biological discovery, helping compress decades of progress into years. With
Claude for Life Sciences
, we're building tools that accelerate the work of scientists and drug developers across the full lifecycle, from early discovery through clinical translation and regulatory review.
As the Applied AI Engineering Manager for Life Sciences, you'll lead the team of engineers who turn that ambition into deployed reality inside the world's leading scientific organizations. Our Applied AI Engineers are the technical front line: they sit with customers, understand their scientific and regulatory workflows in depth, and build the prototypes, integrations, and agents that let Claude do meaningful work in the lab and the clinic. You'll grow and lead this team, own the technical success of our most strategic life sciences accounts, those ties to advancing our strategy and mission, and create the feedback loop that turns what we learn in the field into better products and models.
This is more than wiring up a chatbot. As our own research has shown, the hard part of putting agents to work in biology is the infrastructure beneath them: messy databases, idiosyncratic file formats, scattered APIs, and metadata conventions where a single wrong or missing record can change a scientific conclusion. Your team builds the deterministic tools, connectors, and evaluations that make biological data reliably accessible to agents — and holds the work to a research-grade bar, where an answer has to be correct, reproducible, and auditable, not just plausible.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll coach engineers and raise the bar on their work, stay close enough to the technology to review prototypes and contribute directly, and partner across go-to-market, product, and research. Because this work sits in a sensitive, dual-use domain, you'll also help set the standard for how we deploy responsibly — enabling legitimate science while taking safety seriously.
In this role, you will:
Build and lead the team:
hire, coach, and develop a team of Applied AI Engineers dedicated to strategic life sciences partners, setting a high technical bar and helping each engineer grow.
Own technical success with partners:
be accountable for the technical outcomes of our strategic pharma and biotech deployments, from first scoping conversation through production.
Stay hands-on:
review and contribute to prototypes, MCP integrations, agentic workflows, and Claude Code for Bio solutions; help the team get unblocked on the hardest technical problems.
Build agent-ready scientific infrastructure:
guide the team in creating the deterministic tools, connectors/harnesses, and evaluations that make messy biological data and workflows reliably accessible to Claude — in partnership with scientists and research institutions.
Translate the field into the roadmap:
partner cross functionally to turn what you learn from deployments into improvements in Anthropic's life sciences products and models.
Set the standard for responsible deployment:
work alongside our safety teams to enable beneficial scientific work while guarding against misuse in a dual-use domain.
Build for the frontier
: use deep knowledge of frontier model intelligence coupled to your work in R&D and research to rapidly progress toward solutions to meaningful problems in life sciences.
You may be a good fit if you:
Have led or technically mentored software/ML engineers, ideally in a forward-deployed, solutions, or customer-facing engineering setting.
Have a background in pharma, biotech, computational biology, bioinformatics, or clinical/regulatory affairs.
Have a strong hands-on engineering background and are comfortable reading and writing production code, not just managing those who do.
Have delivered technical work directly with external customers or partners, and can communicate credibly with both technical experts and executives.
Have built on top of large language models or agents
Are energized by an unfamiliar technical domain and have a track record of going deep fast.
Hold a high bar for reliability and reproducibility, and understand why a plausible-looking answer that's subtly wrong can be worse than no answer in scientific work.
Have built tooling, data infrastructure, evals, or agent harnesses that turn messy real-world data into something usable and trustworthy — especially welcome if in a scientific or research setting.
Care deeply about the safe and beneficial deployment of AI, especially in sensitive domains.
Strong candidates may also have:
Experience deploying LLM or agent systems in regulated or enterprise environments.
Experience building MCP servers, developer tooling, or scientific computing pipelines.
Experience scaling a customer-facing technical team through a period of rapid growth.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!

jobs.description: In the Prime Brokerage and Institutional Equity division, we provide our clients around the world with intellectual insights and innovative product solutions and services that help them generate alpha. jobs.description: Job Title: Capacity Manager Job Description Capacity Manager bij Concentrix Als Capacity Manager ben jij de strategische en tactische regisseur van onze personele capaciteit. Je bent de functionele spil in de WFM-keten: van de langetermijnforecast tot de overdracht naar planning en real-time sturing. Jij zorgt dat onze klantteams op ieder moment over precies de juiste bezetting en vaardigheden beschikken. In deze rol opereer je als een taakvolwassen, zelfstandig adviseur en sparringpartner voor Operations, Klantteam Management en onze opdrachtgevers. Je levert niet alleen analyses en scenario’s op, maar neemt proactief stelling, daagt stakeholders inhoudelijk uit en stuurt het WFM-proces functioneel aan om afspraken te borgen. Wat ga je doen? Met een vooruitziende blik (van circa 2 weken tot 15 maanden vooruit) vertaal je klantverwachtingen, volumeprognoses en historische trends naar een sluitend capaciteitsplan. Je overziet de hele keten: poolbeheer, in- en uitstroom, verzuim, verlof en werkplekbehoefte. Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert knelpunten vroegtijdig en regisseert de oplossing. Zie je overschotten, tekorten of schommelingen in verzuim ontstaan? Dan reken je direct 'what-if'-scenario’s door en presenteer je voldragen adviezen op tactisch en strategisch niveau. Daarnaast geef je functionele sturing aan Schedulers en (Senior) Real Time Managers, zodat de uitgangspunten van het capaciteitsplan naadloos worden vertaald naar de dagelijkse operatie. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Regie op het capaciteitsplan: zelfstandig opstellen en beheren van het capaciteitsplan voor meerdere accounts/klantteams over de middellange en lange termijn. Functionele aansturing WFM-keten: locatieoverstijgend sturen op de aansluiting tussen capaciteitsplanning, roosterplanning (Scheduling) en dagelijkse bijsturing (Real Time Management). Proactief & zelfstandig adviseren: Het management, Operations en externe opdrachtgevers gevraagd en ongevraagd adviseren over dienstinrichting, blenden van skills/kanalen en efficiencyverhoging. Scenario- en 'what-if'-analyses: Doorrekenen van beleidswijzigingen, acties, afwijkend verkeer en seizoenspieken, inclusief impact op kosten, FTE en servicelevels. Grip op de pool: Bewaken en forecasten van verzuim, verloop, shrinkage en contracturen; tijdig concrete wervingsopdrachten uitzetten richting Recruitment. Balans bewaken: Zorgen voor een gezonde balans tussen klantdoelstellingen, operationele kosten en een evenwichtig verlof- en beschikbaarheidsbeleid voor de medewerkers. Wie ben jij? Jij bent een stevige persoonlijkheid die zelfstandig opereert en van nature eigenaarschap toont. Cijfers en complexe datasets zijn voor jou gesneden koek, maar jouw echte kracht ligt in de vertaling naar de business . Je hebt een hoge mate van organisatiesensitiviteit: je weet belangen te verbinden, maar durft ook een kritische spiegel voor te houden en tegendruk te geven wanneer de operatie dreigt vast te lopen. Wat breng je mee? Werk- en denkniveau: Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring: aantoonbare ervaring binnen capaciteitsmanagement, tactische workforce management of strategische personeelsplanning (bij voorkeur binnen klantcontact of een dynamische service-omgeving). Zelfstandigheid & advieskracht: ervaring met het zelfstandig adviseren en beïnvloeden van management en externe stakeholders op tactisch/strategisch niveau. Tooling & Data: specialistische kennis van dataverwerking en modellering in Excel en sterke presentatievaardigheden in PowerPoint . Ervaring met toonaangevende WFM-software (zoals Verint, Genesys, Teleopti of vergelijkbaar). Talen: Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels . Hybride werken met échte verbinding: We geloven in de flexibiliteit van thuiswerken, maar vinden persoonlijk contact en een sterke teamdynamiek minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom ontmoeten we elkaar minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Zo sparren we makkelijker, houden we de lijnen kort en bouwen we samen aan een hechte organisatie. Wat bieden wij jou? Een sleutelpositie met veel autonomie, waarin jouw visie en besluiten direct merkbaar zijn in onze operatie en resultaten. Je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap binnen een informele, resultaatgerichte en internationale organisatie. Een passend salaris van €3.850,- tot €5.000, bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en expertise. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week . Een modern hybride werkmodel (flexibel werken vanuit huis en op kantoor). Goede secundaire voorwaarden, waaronder 25 vakantiedagen , pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. Ruime mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling, WFM-certificeringen en doorgroeikansen. Waarom Concentrix? Bij Concentrix geloven we in taakvolwassenheid: wij geven je het vertrouwen, de kaders en de vrijheid om jouw stempel te drukken op onze WFM-dienstverlening. Geen micro-management, maar een rol waarin jij als vakexpert aan het roer staat van een optimale balans tussen mensen, middelen en resultaat. Klaar om de regie te pakken? Solliciteer direct via de button of neem contact op met Patrick Buitendam (Senior Recruiter) via patrick.buitendam@concentrix.com of 06 13 79 08 69 voor meer informatie over de functie. Location: NLD Rotterdam - Weena 505 Language Requirements: Dutch (Required), English Time Type: Full time
